meta.gaugeNote: Gauge A (globalResilienceScore) is a LEADING fragility measure on a 6-18 month horizon: in a downturn three of its five pillars mechanically improve, so the composite cannot signal concurrent stress. Concurrent stress detection lives in stressGauge, which is not averaged into Gauge A.
meta.liquidityNote: Liquidity pillar redefined from discontinued Wilshire 5000 proxy to Buffett Indicator (Total Corp. Equities / GDP), percentile-scored against full history. See fetch_data.py comments.

sahmRealtime.note: Sahm rule, real-time vintage. Known false positive in 2024.

delinquencyAccel.note: 4-quarter change. Threshold = 90th percentile of its own history since 1987.

pillars.name: Cycle
pillars.description: Yield curve spread between 10Y and 2Y Treasuries. Normalizing from inversion historically precedes credit stress by 6–18 months.

pillars.name: Liquidity
pillars.description: Buffett Indicator (Total US Corporate Equities / GDP) at 288.3% — 99.3th percentile vs. its own history since 1947-10-01 (302 quarters). Total corporate equities $91.9T vs. GDP $31.9T (quarter ending 2026-01-01). M2 YoY growth: +5.4%. Updates quarterly with each Fed Z.1 / BEA GDP release, not weekly — a change from the prior (non-functional) daily Wilshire proxy.

pillars.name: Premium
pillars.description: ERP = estimated E/P (3.84%, as of 2026-08-31) minus the 10Y yield (4.77%). The E/P is a manually maintained constant, not a live measurement — this pillar moves only with the 10Y.

pillars.name: Solvency
